input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink an unrestricted licence to distribute, disseminate, license, resell and exploit our Credit Data - i.e. independent exploitation of Client data rather than processing it to deliver the services - which fails the fallback (and preferred) data element; the separate Client Content ownership sentence in Section 13 does not cure it. The Agreement also gives us no rights at all in the results of the Support Services programmer work: they are only treated as Client Proprietary Information under Section 10, with no ownership, assignment or licence, so the fallback deliverables licence elements are unmet. We therefore targeted the fallback: TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d), already met), we take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense work product for our business, and TrueLink's Credit Data licence is limited to providing the Hosting and Support Services.

proposal.summary: Narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to service delivery and add a perpetual licence to Support Services work product
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed TrueLink's licence in our Credit Data so it may only process that data to deliver the services to us, rather than distribute, resell or exploit it, and we added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the work product it creates for us. TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface.
